No content beyond guide scope: index.mdx 'Random Variables and Distributions', topic-01.mdx 'Random variables', topic-02.mdx 'Probability distributions' follow guide's own chapter title and section names.

openstax-u10 (Illowsky & Dean, 2023, Introductory Statistics 2e): Chapter 4 intro confirms 'A random variable describes the outcomes of a statistical experiment in words... X is a discrete random variable' and 'Upper case letters such as X or Y denote a random variable' (matches topic-01.mdx:38-41).
OpenStax Section 4.1 confirms 'Each probability is between zero and one, inclusive' and 'The sum of the probabilities is one' (matches topic-02.mdx:87-91 two checks).
OpenStax Section 4.2 confirms expected value formula 'multiply each value of the random variable by its probability and the products' and 'long-term average' (matches topic-02.mdx:109-123).

lane-u10 (Lane & Ziemer, n.d., Distributions): confirms 'continuous variables... With time measured accurately... no two response times would be expected to be the same' and probability density 'area under the curve equals 1... probability at a single point is always zero... height of the probability function can in fact be greater than one' (matches topic-01.mdx:78-91 continuous definition and topic-02.mdx:135-144 density curve description).

nist-u10 (NIST/SEMATECH, Section 1.3.6.1): confirms discrete probability function properties 'p(x) is non-negative for all real x' and 'sum of p(x) over all possible values of x is 1' (matches topic-02.mdx:87-91); continuous distribution 'integral of the probability function is one' and 'area under the curve between two distinct points defines the probability for that interval' (matches topic-02.mdx:135-144).
